  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  ;; CONSTRAINT: Standard blocksworld with a finite counter for the number of stacks.
  ;; A stack is a tower whose bottom block is on the table.
  ;; The additional constraint requires no more than 3 stacks after a move has been made.
  (:requirements :strips)
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    ;; BEGIN ADD
    ;; CONSTRAINT: finite encoding of stack count
    (started)
    (stack-count ?c)
    (count-ok ?c)
    (transition-minus-one ?from ?to)
    (transition-plus-one ?from ?to)
    ;; END ADD
  )
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b ?from ?to)
    :precondition (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (stack-count ?from)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: picking up a table block removes one stack; resulting count must be <= 3
      (transition-minus-one ?from ?to)
      (count-ok ?to))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (not (on-table ?b))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (started)
      (stack-count ?to)
      (not (stack-count ?from)))
  )
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b ?from ?to)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (stack-count ?from)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: putting down creates a new stack; resulting count must be <= 3
      (transition-plus-one ?from ?to)
      (count-ok ?to))
    :effect (and
      (on-table ?b)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (started)
      (stack-count ?to)
      (not (stack-count ?from)))
  )
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?from)
    :precondition (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: unstacking does not change the number of stacks; count must already be <= 3
      (stack-count ?from)
      (count-ok ?from))
    :effect (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))
      (started))
  )
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?from)
    :precondition (and
      (holding ?b)
      (clear ?c)
      ;; CONSTRAINT: stacking does not change the number of stacks; count must already be <= 3
      (stack-count ?from)
      (count-ok ?from))
    :effect (and
      (on ?b ?c)
      (clear ?b)
      (arm-empty)
      (not (holding ?b))
      (not (clear ?c))
      (started))
  )
)",

  (:requirements :strips :typing :fluents :arithmetic :derived :quantified-expressions :conditional-effects :equality)
  (:types block - object)
  (:predicates

    (on-table ?x - block)
    (clear ?x - block)
    (holding ?x - block)
    (arm-empty)

  ;; BEGIN ADD: weight constraint
  (:functions
    ;; CONSTRAINT: weight of a block is its number
    (weight ?b - block) -> number
    ;; CONSTRAINT: current total weight of blocks above a block
    (load ?b - block) -> number
  )
  (:derived
    ;; CONSTRAINT: transitive above relation derived from direct on relation
    (above ?a - block ?b - block)
      (or
        (on ?a ?b)
        (exists (?x - block) (and (on ?a ?x) (on ?x ?b)))
        (exists (?x - block ?y - block) (and (on ?a ?x) (on ?x ?y) (on ?y ?b)))
        (exists (?x - block ?y - block ?z - block) (and (on ?a ?x) (on ?x ?y) (on ?y ?z) (on ?z ?b)))
        (exists (?x - block ?y - block ?z - block ?w - block) (and (on ?a ?x) (on ?x ?y) (on ?y ?z) (on ?z ?w) (on ?w ?b)))
        (exists (?x - block ?y - block ?z - block ?w - block ?v - block) (and (on ?a ?x) (on ?x ?y) (on ?y ?z) (on ?z ?w) (on ?w ?v) (on ?v ?b)))

      )
    ;; CONSTRAINT: after placing ?b on ?c, every block's total weight above it is <= its weight
    (safe-after-stack ?b - block ?c - block)
      (forall (?z - block)
        (<= (+ (load ?z)
               (if (or (=? ?z ?c) (above ?c ?z)) (weight ?b) 0))
            (weight ?z)))

      (not (clear ?b))

      (assign (load ?b) 0)

    )
  )

    :parameters (?b - block ?c - block)
    :precondition (and (on ?b ?c) (clear ?b) (arm-empty))
    :effect (and

      (clear ?c)
      (not (on ?b ?c))
      (not (clear ?b))
      (not (arm-empty))

      ;; CONSTRAINT: remove weight of ?b from ?c and all blocks below ?c
      (forall (?z - block)
